protocol: SPEC-confirmation-run-r3.md §3.7 item 1 (whole-sentence anchors, §10 item 3) + item 6 / §10 item 2 (a) (five presentations per pair, temperature 0, seeded unit orders)

hallucinated_span_rate.denominator: presentation k = 0 only, as #501's gate was read
hallucinated_span_rate.by_anchor_note: which quoted SENTENCE failed to locate under any of the three ladders (exact / normalised / first-eight + last-eight words in one sentence). #501, with ten-word anchors, had 54 of Scout's 58 failures on the closing anchor; this split is the direct test of r3 §10 item 3

hallucinated_span_rate_all_presentations.note: sensitivity reading over all five presentations; the gate is read on k = 0

locate_ladder.note: k = 0 only. `eight_word` counts the quotes the whole-sentence match missed and the first-eight/last-eight fallback rescued — spans that would have been hallucinations under an exact-or-normalised-only rule

mean_pairwise_span_union_jaccard.note: raw Jaccard, not the >= 0.5 indicator; pairs where BOTH presentations returned nothing are excluded because their Jaccard is 0/0

self_consistency.definition: consistent iff span-union Jaccard >= 0.5 between the two presentations' evidence sets; two 'no localizable evidence' verdicts count as consistent. The gate is read on reading (i), union, over ALL pairs — #501 could only read it on 31.

whether_agreement.definition: fraction of pairs on which all five presentations agree about WHETHER the document contains localizable evidence

union_saturation.label: per judge
union_saturation.distinct_rule: D3 rule 1 — two sets merge iff span-union Jaccard >= 0.5; accumulated in presentation order, k = 0 first
union_saturation.VERDICT: NOT SATURATING — the marginal gain at k = 5 is 0.1022, at or above 0.05 of the union size; a fifth presentation is still adding locations

enumeration_proxy_within_judge.frac_of_k0_sets_still_in_k5_union_note: 1.0 BY CONSTRUCTION, not by measurement: the union is accumulated in presentation order starting from k = 0, so every k = 0 set is a seed of it and cannot be absent. The informative direction is the one above — how much of the five-presentation union ONE presentation recovers.

no_localizable_evidence.gate: descriptive — a legal verdict, not a failure

shape_k0.deep_section_definition: every span of the pair sits in unit index >= 2, i.e. outside the abstract and the first body unit (SS6.6.6 abstract bias; Stage 0 found 3/308)

split_half_union_stability.definition: union of presentations 0-2 vs union of 3-4, span-union Jaccard >= 0.5. Reported because r3 §3.7 item 6 asks whether the UNION is the stable statistic the study needs; the halves are 3 and 2 presentations deep, so this is NOT the >= 0.90 gate re-read.

hallucinated_span_rate.denominator: presentation k = 0 only, as #501's gate was read

asymmetric_coverage.definition: mean over pairs both call positive of the fraction of one judge's selected characters that lie inside the other's. High one way and low the other is under-enumeration; low both ways is genuine disagreement about WHERE.

pooled_saturation.label: pooled (scout ∪ qwen)
pooled_saturation.distinct_rule: D3 rule 1 — two sets merge iff span-union Jaccard >= 0.5; accumulated in presentation order, k = 0 first
pooled_saturation.VERDICT: NOT SATURATING — the marginal gain at k = 5 is 0.1070, at or above 0.05 of the union size; a fifth presentation is still adding locations

cross_judge.definition_kappa: Cohen's kappa on the binary 'does this document contain localizable evidence' verdict. a = scout, b = qwen.

DECISION: **NEITHER JUDGE PASSES THE CONJUNCTION — stop stands per r3 §5 step 2.** scout: self-consistency 0.3831 (FAIL), hallucinated 0.02517 (PASS), whether-agreement 0.9188 (PASS); qwen: self-consistency 0.5617 (FAIL), hallucinated 0.00279 (PASS), whether-agreement 0.9805 (PASS).
UNION_AS_LABELER: **Read as a labeler, the union of five presentations is stable at:** scout 0.4708 (145/308, < 0.90); qwen 0.5779 (178/308, < 0.90). This is the union of presentations 0–2 against the union of 3–4 — halves of unequal depth, so it is a stability statistic and not the ≥ 0.90 gate re-read on a like-for-like pair.
HUMAN_HALF: PENDING-HUMAN — κ(human–human), κ(judge–human), positive-class agreement, the wrong-location / non-minimal / missed-evidence rates and r3 §3.7 item 5's enumeration recall all require the two-reader R-dev read (§6.6.2). No agent read is a substitute and none was performed.
